scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0076; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: “I go to school” and “We go to school” are highly natural A1 school-routine sentences.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: مدرسه directly matches the educational-institution sense selected by the reference.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: The Lesson introduces one concrete noun inside a familiar daily-routine frame.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors contrast the target with a nearby earlier response or a clearly unrelated familiar sentence without creating a second plausible answer.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: A morning route conversation makes going to school contextually immediate.

difficultyFit.evidence: Utterances remain short, reuse established A1 language, and add only the bounded target planned for this Lesson.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: The classmates arc returns ten Lessons after 0066 and rotates the learner role from Maya to Alex.

transferQuality.evidence: The learner changes the subject from I to we while preserving the school destination.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, dialogue, activities, retrieval task, and stated outcome all point to the same bounded learning goal.

learnerExperience.evidence: This is model/editor review only; no real learner test is claimed, so learner-experience confidence is deliberately limited.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
The review is limited to the bounded A1 outcome and does not claim broad mastery of the target word or grammar.
Final generated audio prosody is not evaluated in this text-stage review.
